title: Compare payroll with budget
prompt: A department's payroll is the total salary of its employees. Return department (the department's name) and payroll for every department whose payroll is more than half of its budget. Sort by department.
hints: What has to be worked out before any department can be compared with its budget?
Make a step with one row per department_id and its total salary. Join it to departments.
WITH payrolls AS (SELECT department_id, sum(salary) AS payroll FROM employees GROUP BY department_id) ... WHERE p.payroll > d.budget / 2

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses the average salary instead of the total.
Keeps the departments whose payroll is below half of the budget.

feedback: Add up one department's salaries by hand and compare the total with half of its budget.
